title: Exact stochastic revelation accounting
theorem: For every finite probability pair p,q and column-stochastic K, TV(p,q)-TV(Kp,Kq) equals one half the sum over outputs of incoming absolute signed mass minus absolute net signed mass.
equality_condition: TV is preserved iff each output receives nonzero contribution from at most one sign class of p-q.
novelty_boundary: Total-variation data processing, signed-measure/Jordan-decomposition structure, and triangle-equality conditions are established mathematics; no historical novelty claimed.
